items.title: ARC-032 theta phase-weighted-summary readout: z_goal persistence + goal-proximity-score noise at E3-tick granularity (SD-100 retest of 228c)
items.note: Retest of V3-EXQ-228c per failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-228c_2026-08-10.md, which found 228c's flat-mean ThetaBuffer.summary() PASSED as a first fair E3-tick-restricted direct-DV test but with a REVERSED trend (theta ACTIVE noisier, persist_delta~0) and diagnosed it as a biology-divergence IMPLEMENTATION GAP (flat mean is permutation-invariant, cannot represent Dragoi2006/Colgin2016 within-cycle phase structure), not a claim falsification -- routed to /implement-substrate. SD-100 (docs/architecture/sd_100_theta_buffer_phase_aware_summary.md) landed the fix 2026-08-10 (ree-v3 22b7a3bcff), IMPLEMENTED per ree-v3/CLAUDE.md: config.heartbeat.use_theta_phase_weighted_summary (default False, bit-identical flat mean) + theta_phase_concentration (default 4.0 kappa), a fixed non-trained forward-sweep von-Mises-style kernel. claims.yaml ARC-032 carries pending_retest_after_substrate:true naming exactly this retest. 228d keeps 228c's architecture, measurement protocol, thresholds and seeds byte-identical (the same shared-training/post-P1-deepcopy-split design, E3-tick-restricted persistence_cos + prox_noise_temporal DVs, PERSIST_MARGIN=0.02/NOISE_MARGIN=0.005) and changes ONLY the THETA_ACTIVE arm's summary mechanism (use_theta_phase_weighted_summary=True set on the shared trained agent before the deepcopy split; THETA_ZEROED's monkey-patch to zeros is unchanged and overrides the flag for that clone, so its ablation semantics are bit-identical to 228c). Step 2.5a empirical probe (this session) confirmed the config path is genuinely wired at runtime (agent.theta_buffer.use_phase_weighted_summary reads True from config.heartbeat after REEConfig.from_dims, default-off path unaffected). GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readouts (persistence_cos delta, prox_noise_temporal delta) were only ever measured under the OLD flat-mean summary in 228c -- distinct substrate_hash under the new config, not recoverable by reanalysis -> run fresh. Re-derive brake (2.5b): ARC-032 counted-ceiling count=1 (grandfathered-r6-closure-sweep only) < threshold 2 -- does not fire; also 228c's own disposition was implementation-gap/none-owed-then-owed, not a substrate_ceiling reading. Substrate-path-overlap (2.5c): SD-E3-SCORER-COMPLETION (severity degrading, e3_selector.py) is implemented_pending_validation (untrained scorer heads gated out by default, not yet independently validated) -- non-corrupting, noted not blocking; no open corrupting-severity entry overlaps agent.py/theta_buffer.py/goal.py. If 228d again shows a reversed trend even under the phase-weighted kernel, the driver's own interpretation flags this explicitly as a STRONGER finding (not attributable to flat-mean permutation-invariance) warranting governance re-examination of the implementation-gap routing rather than a further substrate iteration. Smoke PASS (--dry-run, all 6 seed x condition cells verdict PASS; z_goal_stream: active_frac=0.998, no writer defect). validate_experiments.py --strict clean, 0 warnings.

items.title: MECH-321 harm-aware selection, unconditional whole-episode harm rate (n=40 seeds, no screen/tiering, redesigned DV + A-A null control)
items.note: Redesigned MECH-321 harm-aware-selection measurement (chip-20260810-mech321-repose-measurement-queue), ratified by the 2026-08-10 /governance cycle's GOV-DIAG-1 recurrence routing. Design work done in evidence/planning/mech321_harm_aware_selection_measurement_redesign_staged_2026-08-08.md; this entry is the build/queue step only. NEW EXQ NUMBER, not 867c: three design axes changed at once vs 867b -- unit of comparison (every measured seed, no screen/tiering), DV (unconditional whole-episode mean_harm_signal delta, no divergence-tick windowing), sampling (n=40 pre-registered seeds, no exclusion, plus a 4-seed A-A null control). 867b's own manifest shows its screen-soundness falsification was an RNG-reset INSTRUMENTATION ARTIFACT (screen cells bypassed arm_cell's reset; measurement cells did not -- the two phases measured different agents), NOT evidence the manipulation perturbs decomposition; the violation appeared in the OFF arm, which is provably inert (GFLAG-0014/0015/0021, corrected 2026-08-09). Every cell in this driver -- 40 measurement seeds x 2 arms + 4 A-A control seeds x 2 replicates = 88 cells, 1056 episodes -- enters through arm_cell (full RNG reset); there is no bare _run_cell call anywhere. The A-A control discharges the matching-validity precondition BY CONSTRUCTION: any nonzero OFF-vs-OFF delta voids the run (non_degenerate:false, no C1 reading). Readiness (harm_bias_engages) asserted PER-CELL, not per-run aggregate as 867b did. GOV-REUSE-1 checked via reanalysis_query.py (--readout mean_harm_signal --claim MECH-321): all 6 prior MECH-321 manifests carrying this readout have distinct substrate_hash values, none compatible -- not recoverable, run fresh. ree_core/** moved 18 commits since 867b (2026-08-04), so try_reuse_cell is omitted (would refuse on every cell); this run's own ARM_SELECTION_OFF cells are minted reuse-eligible (include_driver_script_in_hash=False) as the current canonical baseline for this lineage. Re-derive brake (2.5b): does not apply -- all four prior autopsies scored non_contributory/measurement_test_design_defect or environment_adequacy_defect (instrument-defect categories the brake's carve-out excludes), never substrate_ceiling. Bar unchanged (EFFECT_SIZE_K_SIGMA=1.0, REL_IMPROVEMENT_FLOOR=0.0); hard n>=40 floor, never softened. `supersedes` deliberately omitted -- 867b is not superseded, it is a different measurement of the same question. Smoke PASS (--dry-run, 3 measurement seeds + 1 A-A control seed x reduced 2-episode schedule): harm_bias engages on every ON cell (min=6>0) and inert on every OFF cell (max=0); A-A control bit-identical (delta=0.0, action sequences equal). validate_experiments.py --strict clean, 0 warnings. Estimated ~21h at 867b's measured 71.7 s/episode -- routed to a cloud worker (any), not the Mac.

items.title: MECH-303 contextual_safety_harm_threshold calibration battery: reachability/discrimination across num_hazards x harm_obs_a sourcing mode
items.note: Diagnostic follow-on to mech303_contextual_safety_threshold_reachability.md (2026-08-11): REEConfig.contextual_safety_harm_threshold defaults to 0.05 but agent.py sense()'s live gate (z_harm_a.norm() < threshold -> accumulate_safety) is unreachable at that default in every prior experiment that exercised it (V3-EXQ-520 overrode to 999; V3-EXQ-764 measured ~0.547 safe / ~0.542 unsafe, both ~11x above 0.05 and barely different). This battery sweeps num_hazards in {0,1,2,4,8} x 10 seeds x 150 ticks, live agent-path z_harm_a (not V3-EXQ-760's ground-truth proxy), across a candidate threshold sweep, reporting per-threshold reachability + AUC(safe-vs-unsafe). Step 2.5a empirical probe (this session) found a mechanistic reframe not anticipated by the original finding: SD-022 re-sources harm_obs_a from body-damage state when limb_damage_enabled=True (the production default every prior driver uses), decoupling z_harm_a from hazard proximity -- the pre-SD-022 legacy direct-proximity-EMA path (limb_damage_enabled=False) discriminates hazard density much better in a 1-seed probe (h0 0.559 vs h4/h8 ~0.72-0.73, vs damage-sourced's non-monotonic 0.547/0.524/0.440/0.380/0.429). So the battery crosses num_hazards x SOURCING_MODE (damage_sourced=production default, proximity_ema_sourced=legacy) as two independent load-bearing criteria (C1/C2, OR-gated overall PASS): C1 alone -> recommend a new default threshold via /implement-substrate; C2 only -> tension is sourcing-mode-specific, not a scalar default fix; neither -> structural SD-011 falsifier, routed to governance/claim-synthesis for the dual-nociceptive-split work. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (5-level battery x 2 sourcing modes x threshold sweep + AUC) is not recorded anywhere -- V3-EXQ-764 measured only 2 ad-hoc points via an inline probe with no manifest (764 itself is HELD, never queued); not recoverable, ran fresh. claim_ids=[SD-011] only (MECH-303 itself and its V3-EXQ-760 evidence are unaffected -- this is a downstream default-config usability question). experiment_purpose=diagnostic. Smoke PASS (--dry-run, 2 seeds x 20 ticks, all 20 cells clean, z_goal_stream correctly recorded as goal-off/unmeasured); validate_experiments.py --strict clean (0 warnings after adding ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT for the reachable-by-construction z_harm_a apparatus precondition).
